task_description: Add 18 accessible UX features to the Chalo Ghumne React frontend (dark mode, site search, back-to-top, mobile menu a11y, loading, hover, scroll progress, copy button, print, sticky header scroll-margin, skip-to-content, password toggle, UTM, form states, confirm modals, last-updated, FAQ, floating contact) on branch feat/ui-features, one focused commit per feature.
